outputs.block:1:text:0: Listen to the music, participate, and touch the instruments...!
outputs.block:4:text:0: Gachapin and Mukku were born in the show "Hirake! Ponkikki," which began broadcasting in 1973. Since then, they have been beloved national characters active for 53 years. In this concert, children can make their classical music debut alongside Gachapin and Mukku. They can enjoy a variety of musical experiences by listening to professional performances, participating together, and touching the instruments.
outputs.block:5:caption:0: Fuji TV Headquarters venue. A classical concert set against the open scenery of Odaiba.
outputs.block:6:text:0: The venue is Fuji TV's spherical observation deck, "Hachitama"
outputs.block:7:text:0: Furthermore, the venue is located inside the spherical observation deck, "Hachitama," on the 25th floor of the Fuji TV headquarters building. It is a concert where families can enjoy classical music while looking out at the open views of Odaiba in a special space and feel energized.
outputs.block:8:caption:0: Mukku playing the piano (*photos are for illustrative purposes) (c) Gachamuku
outputs.block:9:text:0: You can also listen to Mukku's piano performance!
outputs.block:10:text:0: Speaking of Mukku, he is also known for his brilliant piano skills. Being able to hear Mukku play the piano is another highlight of this performance. Ahead of the concert, Gachapin commented, "I'd be so happy if everyone could enjoy classical music together!!" while Mukku shared, "I'm very nervous to play in front of everyone, but I'll practice a lot and give it my best."
outputs.block:11:text:0: Ryukakusan presents Together with Gachapin and Mukku! My First Classical Concert
